import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import ref, main as impl, fuzz
stats = {'complexity':0,'maxstates':0,'maxq':0,'n':0}
for seed in range(300):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    req = fuzz.gen_request(rng)
    exp = ref.compile_reference(req)
    stats['n'] += 1
    if exp == 'E_COMPLEXITY':
        stats['complexity'] += 1
    else:
        m = len(exp['dfa']['next'])
        stats['maxstates'] = max(stats['maxstates'], m)
print(stats)
